install: export BUN_INSTALL="${BUN_INSTALL:-$HOME/.bun}"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(bun --version)" != "1.3.9" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s -- bun-v1.3.9; export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; fi; bun install --frozen-lockfile

terminals.name: convex
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; bun x convex dev
